Name: Sled Valley
Author: LUCASGATICA
Description:
[size=5][b]Sled Valley[/b][/size]

Sled racing mod. You race 7 villagers around Pelican Town and a few other maps, top-down, kart style: drifts, mini-turbos, items, ramps and shortcuts.

Standalone, no other mod needed. Works with Stardew Valley Expanded.

[size=4][b]What's in it[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]5 tracks: Pelican Town Loop, Village Loop, Cindersap Lake Loop (vanilla only), Aurora Vineyard and Crimson Badlands (these two need SVE). The mod picks what fits your town.[/*]
[*]17 items: coffee, snowballs, cherry bomb, crow, lightning, the Wizard's blizzard and more.[/*]
[*]Stuff on the tracks: lava, a sandstorm and a dragon in the Badlands, thin ice on the lake (Willy fishes you out), a Joja truck, Morris with shopping carts, Sophia with wine barrels, Vincent and Jas throwing snowballs.[/*]
[*]Time trial against your own ghost.[/*]
[*]Grand Prix of the Seasons: one race each season (Spring 19, Summer 23, Fall 19) and the final at the Eve Grand Prix, a new festival on Winter 24.[/*]
[*]Copa: a quick cup across the tracks you have.[/*]
[*]Sleds, paints and ornaments to unlock. Cosmetic only.[/*]
[*]Tracks change with the season: grass, sand, leaves, snow.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer and split-screen: everyone can race on their own screen against the villagers. Racing each other on the same track isn't in yet.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]How to play[/b][/size]
Press [b]F7[/b], pick track, difficulty and steering, click [b]Race![/b]
On Winter 24 go to town and talk to Lewis for the Eve Grand Prix.

[size=4][b]Controls[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Steer: WASD / arrows, left stick[/*]
[*]Accelerate (controller): A[/*]
[*]Drift: Space / Left Shift, RB / RT[/*]
[*]Use item: J, LB / LT[/*]
[*]Brake / reverse: K, X / B[/*]
[*]Pause: Esc / P, Start[/*]
[*]Show controls: Tab, Back[/*]
[/list]Keys can be changed in config.json or in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
Stardew Valley 1.6 and [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+. Unzip into Mods.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]SVE: yes.[/*]
[*]Map mods: the track is checked against the map before every race. If it doesn't fit, another track is used, or a plain snow board.[/*]
[*]Festival mods: if another mod already uses Winter 24, the Eve Grand Prix skips that year.[/*]
[*]Safe to add to an existing save.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer: on work[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Languages[/b][/size]
English, Portuguese (BR), Spanish, Vietnamese. Want to translate it? Copy i18n/default.json, translate and send it to me.

[size=4][b]Bugs[/b][/size]
Post in the Bugs tab with your SMAPI log ([url=https://smapi.io/log]smapi.io/log[/url]).

If you liked it, an endorsement helps. And if you want to buy me a coffee: [url=https://ko-fi.com/lucasgatica]ko-fi.com/lucasgatica[/url]
